title: Harden Multi-Site runtime notification parsing against malformed JSON types

opportunity.rootCause: PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY payloads are external input, but the parser called JsonElement.GetString without checking ValueKind; wrong JSON types could throw InvalidOperationException from the notification callback.

implementation: Require schema, operation, and siteId to be JSON strings before reading them.
Reject malformed payloads without throwing and preserve the existing bounded, redacted wake-up contract.

tddRed.reason: Wrong JSON value kinds escaped TryParse as InvalidOperationException.

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY malformed-payload injection and reconnect benchmark
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
